title: 第19章 亲自查探第20章 道子和魔子
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了

境修点了点头：
“女眷失踪，传出去名声不好听。
三家各有各的生意，若是让人知道连家中女眷都保不住，以后还怎么在府城立足？
所以一开始都以为是偶然之事，各自暗中查访。
直到上个月，三家偶然间凑在一起喝茶，聊起这事，才发现不对劲。
三家加在一起，失踪的女眷已经超过十人，而且都是嫡系的重要女眷，不是旁支偏房。”
他从袖中取出一张折好的纸笺，摊开在桌上。
纸笺上写着几行字，字迹工整，是境修的手笔。
“孙家：二房少夫人陈氏，三房庶出小姐孙婉，五房姨娘周氏。
李家：三小姐李娴，大房儿媳王氏，二房嫡女李芸，四房小姐李婵。
刘家：大房长孙女刘玉真，二房小姐刘玉霜，三房姨娘赵氏，还有一位回娘家探亲的表小姐。”
境修一一念来，声音低沉：“共计十一人。失踪时间从两个月前到半个月前不等，间隔越来越短，手法越来越熟练。”
真玄的目光在纸笺上扫了一遍，抬起头，道：“寺中派了人去查？”
“派了。”真武接过话头，面色有些难看。
“半个月前，三家联名向寺中求助。
方丈师兄和你都在闭关，我们几个首座商量着直接去善功堂发了任务。
后来有六名执事接了任务，分两组前往府城查探。”
真玄道：“哪六人？”
真武指了指境修，说道：

“静虑堂接任务的是如明跟如净，如明暗劲圆满，在静虑堂年轻一辈中出类拔萃，而且心思细腻，适合查访。
如净是明劲圆满，是去长见识的。
带队的是你们破妄禅院化劲初期的真龙。”
然后他又指了指自己：
“还有一支队伍带队的是我们这边的真泽，另外两个人是我们这边如力和破妄禅院的如正。
真泽是化劲初期，拳法刚猛，境空师叔的嫡传弟子。
如力是暗劲圆满，轻功不错，擅长潜伏。
如心是暗劲初期，但脑子活络，办事稳妥。”
真玄点了点头，难怪找上了自己。
这六人他都认得，虽算不上一等一的天才，但都是踏实肯干、办事牢靠的弟子。
“查得如何了？”真玄问。
真武的脸色更加难看了，他沉默了片刻，道：“半个月，一筹莫展。”
他站起身，走到墙边挂着的澜沧府城舆图前，指着城中几处标记的红点，道：
“两组弟子分头查访，把三家女眷失踪的地点都走了一遍。
陈氏失踪的城隍庙，李娴失踪的后花园，刘玉真失踪的城外树林，还有其余几处，全都查了个底朝天。”
“查到了什么？”真玄问。
“什么也没查到。”真武的声音里带着几分懊恼，“没有脚印，没有打斗痕迹，没有残留的气息，就像那些人凭空消失了一样。”
境修在一旁补充道：“如明那孩子心思细，他把每一处失踪地点方圆百丈内的每一寸地皮都翻了一遍，连墙缝里的灰尘都取样查验了，还是一无所获。”
真玄沉吟片刻，道：“他们有没有问过三家的护卫和丫鬟？”
“问了。”真武道，“每个人都问了好几遍。但所有人的说辞都一样，人就是一瞬间不见的，没有任何征兆。”

真玄的手指轻轻敲击桌面，没有说话。
真武又道：“更糟的是，三天前，其中一组弟子正面遭遇了嫌疑人。”
真玄的手指停了。

Jing Xiu nodded:
“The disappearance of a female family member has a bad reputation.
Each of the three families has its own business. If people know that they can't even keep the female family members at home, how will they be able to gain a foothold in Fucheng in the future?
So at first they thought it was a coincidence, and each of them secretly investigated.
It wasn't until last month, when the three families got together for tea by chance and talked about it, that they realized something was wrong.
Adding together the three families, there are more than ten missing female dependents, and they are all important female dependents of the direct line, not side families. "
He took out a folded piece of paper from his sleeve and spread it on the table.
There are a few lines of words written on the paper. The handwriting is neat and it is Jing Xiu's handwriting.
"The Sun family: the second wife, Mrs. Chen, the third wife, Miss Sun Wan, and the fifth wife, Mrs. Zhou.
Li family: the third daughter Li Xian, the eldest daughter-in-law Wang, the second daughter-in-law Li Yun, and the fourth daughter Li Chan.
The Liu family: Liu Yuzhen, the granddaughter of the eldest house eldest, Liu Yushuang, the second housewife, Zhao Shi, the aunt of the third house, and a cousin who went back to her parents' home to visit her relatives. "
Jing Xiu thought about them one by one and said in a low voice: "There are eleven people in total. The time of disappearance ranged from two months ago to half a month ago. The intervals are getting shorter and shorter, and the techniques are becoming more and more proficient."
Zhenxuan glanced at the paper, raised his head, and said, "Has the temple sent someone to check?"
"Sent." Zhenwu took over, looking a little ugly.
“Half a month ago, three families jointly asked the temple for help.
Brother Abbot and you are both in retreat, and we several leaders discussed going directly to the Shanggong Hall to send out tasks.
Later, six deacons took over the task and went to Fucheng in two groups to investigate. "
Zhenxuan said: "Which six people?"
Zhenwu pointed at Jingxiu and said:
"The person who took over the task of Jingzu Hall is Ru Ming and Ru Jing. Ru Ming and Dark Jin are perfect. They are outstanding among the younger generation of Jingzu Hall. They have delicate minds and are suitable for investigation.
Rujing is the perfect bright energy, which can gain insights.
The leader of the team is the true dragon in the early stage of transforming energy from your Powang Chanyuan. "
Then he pointed to himself again:
"There is another team led by Zhenze from our side, and the other two people are Ruli from our side and Ruzheng from Powang Chanyuan.
Zhenze is the direct disciple of Master Jingkong who was in the early stage of Huajin and had strong boxing skills.
For example, the force is perfect in dark energy, the light power is good, and the person is good at hiding.
Ruxin is in the early stage of dark energy, but her mind is quick and her work is prudent. "
Zhenxuan nodded, no wonder he found himself.
He recognized all these six people. Although they were not top-notch geniuses, they were all down-to-earth disciples who were hard-working and reliable in their work.
"How's the investigation going?" Zhenxuan asked.
Zhenwu's face became even more ugly. He was silent for a moment and said: "For half a month, I can't do anything."
He stood up, walked to the map of Lancang City hanging on the wall, pointed at several red dots marked in the city, and said:
"The two groups of disciples conducted separate investigations and visited all the places where the female family members of the three families disappeared.
The Chenghuang Temple where Chen disappeared, the back garden where Li Xian disappeared, the woods outside the city where Liu Yuzhen disappeared, and several other places were all investigated thoroughly. "
"What was found?" Zhenxuan asked.
"Nothing was found." Zhenwu's voice was filled with annoyance. "There were no footprints, no traces of fighting, and no residual breath. It was like those people disappeared out of thin air."
Jing Xiu added on the side: "That kid Ru Ming is very thoughtful. He searched every inch of land within a hundred feet of each missing place. He even took samples of the dust in the cracks in the wall, but still found nothing."
Zhenxuan pondered for a moment and said, "Have they asked the guards and maids of the three families?"
"I asked." Zhenwu said, "Everyone asked several times. But everyone said the same thing. People just disappear in an instant without any warning."
Zhenxuan tapped his fingers lightly on the table and said nothing.
Zhenwu added: "What's worse is that three days ago, one group of disciples encountered the suspect head-on."
Zhenxuan's fingers stopped.
